reasoning: This is a GitOps configuration repository that provides Kustomize overlays and Helm charts for deploying and managing OpenDataHub/RHOAI operator dependencies on OpenShift. The repo contains no application code, no operator controllers, and no library modules. Its entire purpose is declarative configuration: reusable Kustomize components per operator (components/operators/), composed Kustomize overlays (dependencies/operators/), post-CRD operator configurations (configurations/), and Helm charts for OCP and non-OCP Kubernetes (charts/). It manages subscriptions, namespaces, operator groups, and custom resource configurations for ~14 dependency operators (cert-manager, Kueue, NVIDIA GPU Operator, etc.).
